budget.reason: From DESIGN.md: only the growth of `done`, amortised. One finished task per tick on average adds a 16-byte entry; doubling growth keeps the average under one allocation and 64 bytes.

driver.input: a board run from seed 7, which keeps a handful of tasks open
driver.one_size_reason: Board::new takes a seed and nothing else; the board grows and shrinks by itself as it runs, so there is no size to choose

same_algorithm.statement: A bounds check stands in for the Python's scan of the list for the blocker. It is a different question, not only a different algorithm: see the example's README.
